damage_sprites.npz.paper: Ivanova et al., Simulating analogue film damage to analyse and improve artefact restoration on high-resolution scans, Eurographics 2023 (arXiv:2302.10004)
damage_sprites.npz.what: Alpha masks of the annotated dust, dirt, short hair, long hair and scratch artefacts cut out of the repository's ten scans of empty 35 mm frames (frame height 3408 px = 24 mm); background subtracted, randomly subsampled (dust 1500, dirt 900, short hair 700, long hair 398, scratch 66).
